newsitem.title: USA: ITT unit's contract signings at record high.
newsitem.headline: ITT unit's contract signings at record high.

text.p: ITT Corp on Monday said its ITT Sheraton unit signed a series of hotel-management contracts and franchise agreements in the past six months, 19 of which are expected to add to earnings immediately.

The Sheraton subsidiary signed 59 hotel management contracts and franchise agreements, which ITT said was a company record for any six-month period. It also signed up 19 new hotels, including its first in Ecuador in South Africa.
